note: Authored game dialogue for fictional characters. The Bednar character's lines are NOT real quotes. Fall 1999: no new university name appears here (team decision 22).

assign.speaker: President Bednar (game character)
assign.text: Thank you for coming. Our college is growing, and our students will need more great teachers.

assign.speaker: President Bednar (game character)
assign.text: Four faculty candidates are waiting in Personnel Services, just down the hall: math, English, art and engineering.

assign.speaker: President Bednar (game character)
assign.text: Walk each one to their department for a teaching demonstration. The art studio's projector has been acting up, so start with art before engineering. Then come back and report to me.

reminder: Candidates still to hire: {list}. They wait in Personnel Services, down the hall.
readyReminder: All four are hired? Wonderful — tell me about them.

report.speaker: President Bednar (game character)
report.text: Math, English, art and engineering — and I hear the Spori's projector works again.

report.speaker: President Bednar (game character)
report.text: These teachers will bless many students. Well done.

greetings.math: Hi! I'm due in the Romney Building to teach the computer science students. They're stuck on binary — I have an idea from Alma 11.
greetings.english: Hello. My demonstration is in the Smith Building — a student's write-up needs a careful red pen.
greetings.art: Hi there! My demo is up in the old Spori's art studio. I'll be teaching the grid method.
greetings.engineering: Ready when you are. I'm demonstrating in the Austin Building's electronics lab.

waiting.engineering: I'm waiting on the art department's demo first — I hear their projector is about to give out.

busy: You're already walking the {other} over. Come back for me after that!
arrive: Lead the way — the {building} is marked on your map.
